candidates.title: World News in Brief: US-Iran war intensifies, aid for Myanmar, casualties in Ukraine
candidates.summary: Fighting between the United States and Iran has sharply escalated after a month-long lull, with the two sides exchanging strikes as fears grow over further civilian casualties.

candidates.title: ‘Every step towards disarmament matters,’ nuclear testing survivors warn
candidates.summary: He was born without arms, a legacy of four decades of nuclear explosions at the Semipalatinsk test site in his native Kazakhstan.
